content:
Programming Language Reference: WebAssembly (Wasm)
Version: WebAssembly 2.0 (W3C Recommendation)
Syntax: Binary instruction format (.wasm) with human-readable S-expression text format (.wat) for a stack-based virtual machine.
Semantics: Deterministic sandboxed low-level bytecode executing at near-native speed, independent of hardware architecture.
Type System: Compact static type system: 4 numeric value types (i32, i64, f32, f64), vector types (v128 SIMD), and reference types (externref, funcref).
Memory Model: Linear memory: continuous unmanaged byte array resizable in 64KiB pages, bounds-checked at runtime.
Concurrency: WebAssembly Threads proposal: shared linear memory via SharedArrayBuffer and atomic instructions (atomic.wait / notify).
Error Handling: Traps (halts execution on integer division by zero, invalid memory access), Wasm Exception Handling proposal.
Standard APIs: WebAssembly JavaScript API (WebAssembly.instantiate), WASI (WebAssembly System Interface)
Specification: W3C WebAssembly Core Specification (https://webassembly.github.io/spec/core/)
Official Docs: https://webassembly.org/docs/
